contentSection.heading: Our Product

items.description: Wooden Finish Cabin combines natural warmth with modern elegance, creating a cozy and stylish elevator experience.

The Wooden Finish Cabin brings a warm and inviting touch to modern elevator design. Infused with the charm of natural textures, this cabin blends classic aesthetics with modern performance. Perfect for premium residences, heritage buildings, and hotels, it offers a sophisticated ambiance that leaves a lasting impression on every passenger.

contentSection.description: Designed to reflect the natural elegance of wood, this cabin comes with beautifully laminated wooden panels or wooden-texture stainless steel finishes, available in a variety of shades and grains to suit your building's interior theme.

items3.text: Elegant laminated wooden panels or wood-texture stainless steel finishes
Available in various shades and grains to match interiors
False ceiling with integrated LED lights and blower for comfort
Fully automatic centre-opening or telescopic doors
Doors finished to complement wooden tones for seamless design

contentSection.heading8: Crafted for Comfort, Built for Durability
contentSection.description2: While the visual appeal is rooted in tradition, the technical features are engineered for modern reliability. The Wooden Finish Cabin includes LED digital indicators at hall levels, plasma indicators inside the car, and sleek SS90 square buttons for easy operation.

items4.text: LED digital indicators at hall levels
SS90 square buttons for easy operation
Optional upgrades like custom panels and ambient lighting
